title: A question to the owner stands on its own
label: dev

checks.name: there is a question to judge

reasons: The question is mostly clear: it says what the task is, what conflict came up, which option is recommended and what happens by default.
Minor jargon slip: "main" (a branch name) and "commit" are used without saying what they mean.
Each option says what will happen, for example who closes the pull request, whose work survives, or that nothing gets built.
"The old form" and the untranslated «Substituir» label are slightly vague for someone who has forgotten the task.
At about 114 words, it is just under the 120-word limit.
